name: S4 Overload Probe
description: Open-model overload scenario. Uses the same read profile as S1 (keyset-paginated and single-resource reads) but is driven by a fixed request arrival rate (req/s) instead of a fixed number of clients. Pairs with closed-model S1 to compare read plateau (closed) versus the offered rate at which latency, error_rate, and dropped_iteration_rate reveal the breaking point (open).
